description: A Rowmill home page: a floating navbar, a hero where the lines of a bank statement are read one by one into the rows of a table that copies as CSV, a manifesto that lights word by word with the scroll, three steps as rows, a grid of banks with a region filter, a comparison table whose figures roll with the length of the statement, reviews to drag through and a footer with a local clock.
